newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hurricane Lili winds hit Germany north coast.
newsitem.headline: Hurricane Lili winds hit Germany north coast.

text.p: Hurricane strength winds hit the East Fresian Islands off Germany's north coast on Tuesday and maritime authorities issued a warning that water levels were rising sharply.

The water level was around one and a half metres (five feet) higher than normal along the whole coast at midnight, as the fringes of Hurricane Lili which lashed Cuba and the Bahamas ten days ago, hit the islands, a Federal Maritime Office spokesman said.
The water level was likely to rise further in next few days, he said.
